claims.object_text: focal epilepsy through hyperactivation of the mechanistic target of rapamycin pathway
claims.quote: Pathogenic variants in the GAP activity towards RAGs 1 (GATOR1) complex genes (DEPDC5, NPRL2, NPRL3) cause focal epilepsy through hyperactivation of the mechanistic target of rapamycin pathway.
The patient with NPRL3-related epilepsy had seizure worsening.
